# chaplin · v1.1.0

Source: https://chaplin.hexdocs.pm/

# Chaplin

[Mustache](https://mustache.github.io/) text templates using Erlang’s [bbmustache](https://github.com/soranoba/bbmustache) package.

```
import chaplin
pub fn main() {
  let assert Ok(template) = chaplin.compile("Hello, {{name}}!")
  let rendered = chaplin.render(template, [
    #("name", chaplin.string("World")),
  ])
  assert rendered == "Hello, World!"
}
```
Further documentation can be found at [https://hexdocs.pm/chaplin](https://hexdocs.pm/chaplin).

---

# chaplin · chaplin · v1.1.0

Source: https://chaplin.hexdocs.pm/chaplin.html

The error that can happen when compiling a template.

```
pub type CompileError {
  FileNotFound
  IncorrectSection(String)
  InvalidDelimiters
  UnclosedSection(String)
  UnclosedTag
  UnsupportedTag(String)
}
```
### Constructors

-
          `FileNotFound`
-
          `IncorrectSection(String)`
-
          `InvalidDelimiters`
-
          `UnclosedSection(String)`
-
          `UnclosedTag`
-
          `UnsupportedTag(String)`
